name: Imola
description: The Autodromo Enzo e Dino Ferrari, laid out along the Santerno at Imola and opened in 1953. Dino's name went up in 1970 and Enzo's in 1988. One of the few significant circuits run anti-clockwise, and the Italian teams' test track for a quarter of a century before it took a Grand Prix of its own in 1980.
